feedback:
Decision: revise. The candidate is the iteration 6 controller (base_speed 0.9, kp 1.4, ki 0, kd 0.5, line_loss last_direction, y 0.07) with a proposed widening of the outer sensors. The rationale describes outer sensors at x = ±0.040 m with middle sensors at -0.02, 0, +0.02, but the geometry block still lists x = ±0.032 m at 0.016 m spacing. The submitted geometry therefore does not test the change the rationale describes. Revise so the sensor positions match the stated intent.

Evidence for the change. Iteration 6 (base 0.9, kd 0.5, kp 1.4, y 0.07, x ±0.032) is the best raced design at 683.7. Its slalom ended off_track in all 20 runs at progress 0.392, with max_error pinned at the 0.06 m limit (mean 0.0646). Iteration 8 showed that moving the sensors forward to y 0.075 lowered slalom progress to 0.328, so forward lead is not the lever. Lateral reach is the variable not yet tested, which is why the outer span is worth one controlled trial. The off-track limit is max(0.06, 0.0125 + 0.12/4) = 0.06 m, so body width cannot help.

Evidence against other moves. Iteration 9 (kd 0.6, otherwise identical to iteration 6) scored 676.8 with slalom progress 0.351, so kd 0.6 is not the fix. Iterations 7 and 8 (base 0.85; y 0.075) also lowered slalom progress. Keep kd 0.5, base 0.9, kp 1.4 and y 0.07 fixed so the span is the only change.

What to do with the next race. If the oval and s-bend stay at 20/20 and slalom progress rises above 0.40, keep the wider span. If s-bend finishes fall below 18 of 20 or s-bend steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35, return x to ±0.032 m, since the outer sensors are then seeing the tape on curves too early. If slalom progress stays near 0.39 with no change, the slalom's sharpest turn geometry is the limit, and the final iteration should lock the best measured design (iteration 6 settings).
requested_changes: Make the geometry match the rationale: set sensor_positions x to -0.040, -0.020, 0.000, 0.020, 0.040, all at y 0.07, with sensor_size 0.016 and sensor_weights [-2,-1,0,1,2]. Keep base_speed 0.9, kp 1.4, ki 0.0, kd 0.5 and line_loss last_direction, as in iteration 6 (683.7), so the outer span is the only change.

If s-bend finishes fall below 18 of 20 or s-bend steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35 in the next race, revert the outer sensors to x ±0.032 m. Iteration 6 showed the s-bend at 20/20 with oscillation 0.29 at that span.

Do not change kd or base_speed in this revision. Iteration 9 showed kd 0.6 lowered slalom progress to 0.351, and iterations 7 and 8 showed that base_speed 0.85 and y 0.075 also lowered it, so these gains and speeds are not the open lever.
